description: Pins the device-local vault-bound person-identity carrier AAD (aad_person_vault_carrier: role 'person-vault-carrier-blob', binding vault_id || person_id under the v0.2 AAD prefix). The carrier's KEK is DeriveSubkey_v0_2(root_key, 'person-vault-carrier'), pinned by the hkdf-sha256/v0.2 family; this family pins the AAD framing. A port that binds a different id order or role string opens nothing. myne-md/myne#792, decisions/protocol/0622.

cases.description: AAD for the carrier: the v0.2 prefix || protocol byte || length-prefixed role 'person-vault-carrier-blob' || vault_id || person_id. The vault_id binding stops a carrier mislaid under another vault name from opening; the person_id binding stops a carrier sealed for a different person from being accepted. 70 bytes.
